"An ideal guard? I would rather have the complaining courier back tomorrow. Keep the job where you can ask us for help instead of disappearing into that title."
Leen folds her arms and stays beside Ren.

"A title will not fetch you off that road. Ask for a second patrol member, or keep the courier work; you said you can decline."
Leen holds up one finger while pointing out the missing support.

"Ten thousand for one stupid laugh. I am not paying that."
Leen lowers the cushion without throwing it.

"Keep laughing, then!"
Leen flings the cushion toward the closed door.
